content.text: Resolved T-5003. The payout-sender pod is healthy and unchanged since May 6; its logs show Northbridge Pay started returning `403 ip_not_allowlisted` for egress IP `34.201.17.88` on May 19, which is a vendor-side allowlist change rather than a Kubernetes issue. I left a note directing treasury ops to re-add `34.201.17.88` to the merchant MRC-20931 allowlist in the Northbridge portal; the sender's retry loop will then drain the queue on its own. I did not add doc citations because the finding came entirely from live cluster/log evidence, not from a documented behavior.
